lines.text: Many learners say: Turn light at the corner.
Better: Turn right at the corner.
Light is a lamp. Right is a side.
Right! Turn right at the corner.

data.why: Light is a lamp. Right is a side.

native.tip: 한국어는 ㄹ 하나로 r과 l을 말해서 헷갈리기 쉬워요. 오른쪽은 right! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “Turn right at the corner.”

en.hook: Do not write light for right!
en.tip: Light is a lamp. Right is the side. Say “Turn right at the corner.”
en.caption: Do you say “Turn light at the corner” in English? 😅 Light is a lamp, and right is the side you turn to! “Turn right at the corner” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
